dct_title_s: Education Facilities of Central African Republic
dct_description_sm: Education facilities: schools, kindergartens, colleges, and universities tagged via `amenity` or `building`. Useful for school-access mapping, education planning, and resource allocation. Coverage reflects where volunteer mappers have been active. Urban areas are usually well represented, remote areas may be sparse. Cross-check critical decisions with local field knowledge. - Source: [OpenStreetMap](https://www.openstreetmap.org), a free, collaborative world map - Tags: [amenity](https://wiki.openstreetmap.org/wiki/Key:amenity), [building](https://wiki.openstreetmap.org/wiki/Key:building) - Part of the [exports grid on HDX](https://data.humdata.org/organization/hot/) by [HOT](https://www.hotosm.org/)
